caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object positioned in the center of an otherwise blank, cream-colored background. The object appears to be a decorative metallic key or handle, rendered in shades of gold and brown. It features intricate patterns and flourishes along its shaft and handle, with a straight cylindrical section on the left transitioning into a more elaborate, sculpted end on the right. Just below and to the right of the object, the name “HARRY GROSSEN” is written in small, uppercase letters. The overall composition is minimal, with the central object being the only element of detail against the uniform background.
title: Watch Key
